name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.1 degrees north of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 18 times in 6 visits over 51 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 35 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.1 days starting 2025-05-16, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 3.99 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
